name: Bachelor of Engineering Technologies (Advanced Manufacturing)
reason: Confirmed real and specifically named, but not yet independently enrolling: TAFE Queensland's own live Associate Degree in Applied Technologies page (HED012, /course/19/19442) states graduates are "on the path to further advanced studies, with articulation options into the Bachelor of Engineering Technologies and related qualifications" - naming it as a genuine forthcoming/pathway qualification. But it has no course code, no course page, and no HED listing of its own anywhere on tafeqld.edu.au (checked the 555-course catalogue, the admission-ranking HED table which only runs to HED012, and a full-site search). The Associate Degree feeding into it only launched in March 2026 per TAFE Queensland's own news article, consistent with the Bachelor not yet being live. Same shape as CQU's Master of Data Analytics honest-null precedent: a real, cited, named future qualification, not a research gap.
